# Third-party libraries whose examples the regression check builds, for
# every board (.github/scripts/compile_third_party.sh). Pinned, so that a
# new release of a library can't turn the check red on its own; move a
# version on by hand. Installed with --no-deps, so a library's
# dependencies are listed here too (DHT sensor library needs Adafruit
# Unified Sensor).
#
# They are the ones this core has been checked against by hand: in 0.7.0
# (ArduinoJson to Adafruit Unified Sensor) and 0.10.0 (Ethernet and
# PubSubClient, on the network base classes), and the official SD library,
# which release_check 23 and ArduinoJson's JsonConfigFile example use.
ArduinoJson@7.4.3
LiquidCrystal@1.0.7
DHT sensor library@1.4.7
Adafruit NeoPixel@1.15.5
OneWire@2.3.8
Adafruit BusIO@1.17.4
Adafruit Unified Sensor@1.1.15
Ethernet@2.0.2
PubSubClient@2.8.0
SD@1.3.0
